text: I might be making a fuss over nothing. My granddaughter is 3, she's got a temp of 39 and a sore throat. She is drinking her juice. But she's just not herself, she's very sleepy and floppy, lying on the sofa and not really answering me when I talk to her, normally she'd be chattering away even when poorly. Her mum says it's just the fever but it doesn't feel right to me
